findings.summary: crates/server/src/board.rs:59: no test checks that a card's gate can come from its PR's branch records. I changed gates::latest(issue.gates.iter().chain(pr.and_then(|p| p.gate.as_ref()))) to gates::latest(issue.gates.iter()), and every board-server test still passed. Still open from Verify round 5. End to end it works: TRU-6 showed Adversarial review round 1 from its records once its comments were removed.

crates/server/src/github.rs:109-125: without a token, the 45-request cap is spent in repo order, and every read asks again for check runs of every open PR. If the first repo has about 22 or more open tied PRs, later repos are never listed: in the run with 30 made-up PRs, bbooth/sdlc-board was 'not sent ... (no earlier PRs)'. The last open PRs also stay 'checks unknown' on every read. That only happens at a volume these repos don't have today (the real first read was 15 requests).

Verification environment: the egress proxy adds a GitHub credential to requests to api.github.com (a curl with no token got X-RateLimit-Limit 15000). The server's own requests carried no real token, but its upstream reads were authenticated by the proxy, so GitHub's real 60-an-hour anonymous limit and its 403s were not observed. No sdlc-board PR exists for TRU-10, so the green-PR merge item used real booking PR #53 served as open, and Stage labels were overridden through the Linear proxy. Everything else was real data.
